name: fill_accept_out_cache_loc
description: fill_accept_out_cache_loc(accept_index, out_cache_loc, accept_out_cache_loc, size) -> accept_out_cache_loc. Consider only accept_index[:size]. Entries greater than -1 are kept, compacted toward the front in their original order, and filled with out_cache_loc at those indices; let n be the number of kept entries. The native kernel writes the first n positions of the supplied accept_out_cache_loc in place and returns that same tensor. Positions beyond n have no defined value from the op and retain whatever the caller supplied. size <= 0 returns the input buffer unchanged. The exercised inputs are int64, and accept_out_cache_loc is both mutated and aliased as the return value.
